product_metadata.title: Yancorp 2 Panels Bedroom Curtain 63 inch Length Sheer Curtains Linen Yellow Grey Ombre Rod Pocket Drapes for Girls Living Room Mermaid Bedroom Nursery Kids Window Decor(Yellow Grey, 52"x63")
features: PACKAGE: includes 2 Pieces of two-colored ombre sheer voile curtains.

SIZE: 8 sizes to choose from, such as: W40''*L63'', W40''*L72'', W40''*L84'', W40''*L96'', W52''*L63'', W52''*L72'', W52''*L84'', W52''*L96'. Top Header Measure 1.3 inches tall, Top and Bottom pockets measure 2.5 inches tall. Suitable for Rod diameter 1.6 inches.
MATERIAL: Made of 100% Linenette durable premium faux linen polyester fabric. Offers more privacy compared to normal transparent sheers while still letting natural light coming through.
DESIGN: Special design with 2 colors ombre from each end, gives you a romantic look romantic look to liven up any home decor.
CARE INSTRUCIOTN: Our Ombre voile curtains are machine washable in gentle cycle and cold water. Warm iron and tumble dry at low temperatures.
